title: Interference of Coherent Beams in Free Space: reproducible analytical checks and figures
description: Code that numerically verifies the analytical results and regenerates all figures of the article 'Interference of Coherent Beams in Free Space: Separating Field Structure, Detector Response, and Back-Action'. Includes the crossing-plane-wave benchmark, crossed preparation-detector residual test, visibility identifiability analysis (coherence versus detector coupling), and quantum detection-channel checks. No experimental data.
